controls.why_not_one_block_off: Band flanked by Mechanic even run 21xx (2126/2128, Security Building block) north and 22xx (2202/2204) south on sheet 9; odd 2127 north (ship-chandler block) and 2201 south on sheet 10 -- the 21xx->22xx rollover occurs only across 22nd St; street numerals 200-series (sheet 9) vs 300-series (sheet 10) match the index split *9/*10.
controls.anchor_evidence: Sheet 9: numerals 222/224 (N) / 219-223 (S); Mechanic evens 2126/2128 (N corner), 2202/2204 (S corner); 12" W. PIPE mid-street; '80''. Sheet 10: 302-308 (N) / 301,A303B,A305B,307 (S); Mechanic odds 2127 (N corner, '50'' depth), 2201 (S corner); 12" W. PIPE; '80''.

A.measured_at: east end of frontage, corner adjacent to Ave C
